assessment.nobel_worthiness: Recruiting E3 ligases to destroy rather than inhibit a target is a genuinely new pharmacological modality: induced proximity by a designed bifunctional molecule or a molecular glue, with clear design rules and a pipeline of clinical degraders. It changed what chemists and clinicians can do with 'undruggable' proteins, which is the test I apply most.
assessment.attribution: Crews and Deshaies launched the PROTAC concept (2001) and Crews developed the first small-molecule versions; Ciulli made VHL ligands and the structural basis for ternary-complex design. Handa, Ito and Gray are also credible, and the molecular-glue/thalidomide thread overlaps with prior recognition of Ciechanover, Hershko and Rose, so the exact configuration is genuinely open.
assessment.maturity: Concept validated by many independent groups and by late-stage clinical degraders; interpretation of ternary-complex cooperativity is stable. Timing is good, though regulatory approval of a degrader drug is still pending.
uncertainties: Whether the prize should centre on bifunctional PROTACs or on molecular glues and cereblon biology
Clinical approval not yet established
Allocation among at least five or six strong contributors

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Orthogonal aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase/tRNA pairs that incorporate designed non-canonical amino acids into proteins in living cells give chemistry direct access to the proteome: precise probes, crosslinkers, post-translational-modification mimics and biotherapeutics. It is a clear case of molecular design producing control over recognition that spreads across biology and medicine.
assessment.attribution: Schultz and Wang established the first in vivo incorporation in E. coli and then in eukaryotes; Chin extended it to multicellular organisms, quadruplet codons and orthogonal ribosomes. A three-person split is natural; Mehl and Yokoyama are important but less decisive.
assessment.maturity: Widely reproduced for more than two decades with commercial and clinical adoption; the field is mature. Directed-evolution and phage-display prizes (2018) are adjacent but this is a distinct accomplishment.
uncertainties: Relative weight of Schultz versus Chin and Wang in the foundational steps
Overlap with the 2018 evolution prize may be argued

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Single-molecule electrical sensing of nucleic acids and other analytes through protein nanopores is a measurement principle that became a practical sequencing technology and a general platform for bioanalytical sensing. It combines molecular engineering of the pore with detection physics, which I find compelling both scientifically and for translation.
assessment.attribution: The concept and first demonstrations (Kasianowicz, Brenner, Deamer, Branton), pore engineering (Bayley), and strand-by-strand reading with a motor enzyme (Akeson, Deamer) are distributed across several people. I lean toward Branton, Bayley and Akeson but credit is clearly contested, which weakens the case.
assessment.maturity: Commercially deployed for over a decade and independently confirmed in many applications; very mature. Credit disputes are the main hindrance to timeliness.
uncertainties: Whether Kasianowicz or Deamer should displace one of the three proposed names
Distinction between concept, pore engineering and sequencing implementation is not settled by the supplied text

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Base editors chemically convert one base into another with a deaminase fused to a Cas-nickase, without double-strand breaks. They are a prime example of protein-chemistry design applied to the genome, with immediate therapeutic relevance, and they extend the CRISPR toolkit already recognised in 2020.
assessment.attribution: David Liu led both the cytosine and adenine base editors, with Komor and Gaudelli as the lead inventors. A Liu-centred prize is simple; Nishida and Kondo's independent cytidine deaminase editor adds attribution complexity.
assessment.maturity: Strong independent replication and first clinical-stage data; timeliness is good but the long-term clinical record is still short. B061 prime editing is closely related and I rank only one of the two to avoid duplication.
uncertainties: Whether the Academy would regard this as sufficiently distinct from the 2020 CRISPR prize
Long-term safety and efficacy in patients
Treatment of the Nishida/Kondo contribution

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Liquid-liquid phase separation as an organising principle for membraneless compartments changed how we think about intracellular chemistry, bringing polymer physics, multivalent interactions and intrinsically disordered proteins into cell biology. The conceptual impact is large, and it links directly to my interest in peptide self-assembly.
assessment.attribution: Brangwynne and Hyman showed P-granule liquid-like behaviour (2009); Rosen demonstrated multivalent-interaction-driven phase separation; Pappu and Mittag supply the physical-chemical framework. A trio is plausible but the boundary is arguable.
assessment.maturity: Rapidly growing but still contested: physiological relevance, definitions of condensates and artefacts of overexpression are being debated, so it may be somewhat premature. Therapeutic and technological spin-offs are early.
uncertainties: Physiological relevance of many reported condensates remains disputed
Whether it is more naturally a physiology or biology prize than a chemistry prize
Which of Pappu, Mittag, Rosen is the third laureate

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Activity-based probes report on enzyme function rather than abundance, enabling proteome-wide discovery of druggable sites and inhibitor selectivity profiling in native systems. It is a chemistry-driven platform that changed target discovery and covalent ligand development.
assessment.attribution: Cravatt originated and generalised activity-based protein profiling, with Bogyo and Overkleeft developing important probe classes. Cravatt alone would be defensible; Weerapana's chemoproteomic work is additional, not decisive.
assessment.maturity: Mature, widely used in academia and industry for nearly three decades; the covalent-ligand follow-ups are still evolving. Timely but not urgent.
uncertainties: Whether credit would be shared beyond Cravatt
Overlap with covalent drug discovery (B035) in how the Academy frames the prize

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Quantitative, shotgun and large-scale mass-spectrometric proteomics enabled systematic measurement of proteins, modifications and interactions across biological systems and clinical samples, a bioanalytical foundation for modern molecular medicine.
assessment.attribution: Mann, Aebersold and Yates are the usual core trio spanning the instrumental/informatic strategies (MS-based proteomics, SRM/targeted, multidimensional identification technology). Hunt, Gygi and Heck are strong too, so allocation is difficult. Fenn and Tanaka already received the ionisation prize in 2002.
assessment.maturity: Highly mature and widely validated; the risk is that it is a platform with many contributors and the 2002 prize already honoured the core ionisation steps.
uncertainties: Large field with many credible contributors
Distinct enough from the 2002 ionisation prize?
Clinical impact is still maturing

assessment.nobel_worthiness: DNA-programmed nanoparticle assembly and spherical nucleic acids link sequence-specific recognition to nanomaterial structure and function, with widespread use in colorimetric biosensing, intracellular gene regulation and diagnostics. This sits close to my own work on biomolecule-nanoparticle hybrids, so I am attentive to both its strengths and its limits.
assessment.attribution: Mirkin's group made the foundational demonstrations (1996) and the spherical nucleic acid concept; Alivisatos independently reported DNA-nanocrystal assembly the same year. Mucic and Storhoff were trainees, so a Mirkin-and-Alivisatos configuration is plausible.
assessment.maturity: Commercial diagnostics exist (e.g. Verigene) but therapeutic translation is still limited; independent reproduction is broad but the conceptual novelty of the prize is more modest than the others I ranked.
uncertainties: Therapeutic translation has been modest
Alivisatos' 2023 recognition context (quantum dots was awarded to others) and whether he is the right co-laureate
Practical reproducibility and stability of conjugates
